resources.string: Location sharing status
Shows while this phone is sharing its location or sharing is paused.
Sharing your location
End-to-end encrypted. Only your groups can see it.
Location sharing paused
Your groups can\'t see where you are.
Sharing starts again at %1$s.
Sharing starts again tomorrow at %1$s.
Sharing starts again on %1$s at %2$s.
Sharing alerts
When this phone stops sharing its location or needs you to do something.
Update Open Beacon
This phone has stopped sharing your location. Update the app to start sharing again.
Location sharing paused
We\'re updating Open Beacon\'s servers. Sharing will start again shortly.
Your server needs updating before this phone can share its location again.
The app and your server don\'t match. Open the app for details.
Location sharing stopped
Open Beacon can no longer use your location all the time. Tap to turn it back on.
Signed out of Open Beacon
This phone was removed from your account and has stopped sharing your location.
This phone has stopped sharing your location. Sign in again to keep sharing.
Location sharing turned back on
You turned sharing on from another device. Tap to start sharing from this phone.
Location sharing changed
Sharing was changed from another device. Tap to update this phone.
